parsedVerdict.reasoning: All four files deal with one concern: the HTTP delivery adapter built on Express. app.ts builds the Express app and wires in the middleware. routes.ts maps paths to controller handlers through the Controllers interface. requestParsing.ts holds the shared rules for checking request fields. The graph shows that the error type is created only in requestParsing.ts and used by middleware/errorHandler.ts, so the module's own abstraction is used consistently and nothing goes around it.
